most_similar_reason: Candidate 6 shares the same core distinctive episode-set as the target almost point for point: a murdered brother-king dismembered by a jealous sibling, a wife/sister who searches for and reassembles the scattered pieces, magical revival to conceive a posthumous son, the king becoming lord of the underworld, and the son eventually avenging him.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 7 is a self-contained trickster-spider cycle about stories, wisdom, and tricking a sky god, sharing only the vague motif of a divine trickster figure with no correspondence to the death, dismemberment, resurrection, or kingship struggle central to the target.
